rules.statement: A temperature reading must be a finite number.
rules.subject: reading temperature

rules.statement: The ice counts as warm only when the reading is above the warm threshold temperature; at or below it, the warm period resets.
rules.subject: ice temperature

evidence.quote: if (at - since < WARM_WINDOW_MS) return { warm: true };

rules.statement: The next session is put on hold only after the ice has stayed warm continuously for at least the warm window.
rules.subject: continuous warm duration

rules.statement: Only a session in the scheduled status can be put on an ice hold.
rules.subject: session status

rules.statement: The session considered for an ice hold is the earliest one that is not cancelled and whose start time is at or after the reading time.
rules.subject: session start time

rules.statement: When a session is put on hold, only holders of paid or pending bookings who have a phone number get a text.
rules.subject: booking status
